{"consolidated_memory":"PLATFORM CONFIG LOADER - MULTIPLE INCIDENTS WITH WRONG ENVIRONMENT MANIFESTATION

All three incidents occurred in platform/config/loader.py (platform side). All share the same symptom (production endpoint appearing in staging process) and the same repro step (boot service with unset profile variable). All are covered by tests/platform/test_config_loader.py.

INCIDENT 1 [2026-06-12] - c021-e1
Trigger: Input list came in empty
Root cause: Connection pool exhaustion under burst load
Fix: Raised the pool ceiling and added a bounded wait queue in front of it
PR/Branch: PR #3439 on branch fix/wrong-environment-2
Outcome: Flaky test went from 37 failures per 100 runs to zero

INCIDENT 2 [2026-07-31] - c021-e3
Trigger: Deeply nested inputs beyond six levels
Root cause: Error swallowed by bare except clause
Fix: Narrowed the exception handler and let the failure propagate
PR/Branch: PR #4886 on branch fix/wrong-environment-4
Outcome: Error rate dropped from 6.3 percent to under 2 per 10,000

INCIDENT 3 [2026-08-10] - c021-e5
Trigger: Payloads above roughly two megabytes
Root cause: Two writes that were never wrapped in a transaction
Fix: Wrapped both writes in one transaction
PR/Branch: PR #7674 on branch fix/wrong-environment-6
Outcome: Nightly rollup matched the source counts for 69 days running"}
